mapper.insert: INSERT INTO AIR_STATION( station_name, addr, mang_name, lat, lng, started_year, items_text ) VALUES ( #{stationName}, #{addr}, #{mangName}, #{lat}, #{lng}, #{startedYear}, #{itemsText} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE addr=#{addr}, mang_name=#{mangName}, lat=#{lat}, lng=#{lng}, started_year=#{startedYear}, items_text=#{itemsText}
